correctness.rationale: C5 checks replicate: connected, triangle-free, planar, n=5, no separating vertex/edge, zero induced C4 so non-CFS by Dani-Thomas square-graph criterion. Square-free triangle-free RACG is hyperbolic by Moussong, one-ended, non-elementary with exp global divergence. Finite-index torsion-free kernel argument (index 32, chi_orb=-1/4, chi=-8, genus 5) gives QI to H^2; polar detour pi*sinh(r)~exp and Tran QI-invariance transfer Spec={[exp]}. Inferences are proof, computations verified; cited black boxes used legitimately.

originality.rationale: Headline Spec(G_C5)={[exp]} is mechanically implied by prior stronger facts: Moussong hyperbolicity for square-free C5 plus Tran Example 4.7 that a one-ended hyperbolic group has exp-only spectrum. Tran's general theorem substantively implies the C5 instance without stating C5 verbatim, so under the substantive-implication rule originality FAILS. The C5 non-CFS/hyperbolic facts are standard criteria applications, not new boundaries.

value.rationale: ADMISSION_DEFECT: the admitted universal two-point wording presupposed non-empty CFS peripherals realizing [r^2], but the Standing-Assumptions class contains hyperbolic empty-peripheral members with C5 the smallest (n=5) case. Refuting the universal by C5's vacuous peripheral clause is vacuity/cheap small-instance mismatch, not a substantive spectral advance. The singleton itself is a direct corollary of Tran's hyperbolic principle and the coarse non-blindness was already shown by Tran's infinite exp-divergence family with distinct spectra.
